summary: KPChat rebrand feature adds (CountryPicker + AppLogo + auto-OTP hints) tested end-to-end on Expo web preview at 390x844. ALL primary acceptance criteria PASS. Login screen: KPChat PNG logo renders (img[src*=kpchat-logo] count=1) — no Ionicons chat bubble; login-country-picker shows '🇮🇩 +62' by default; login-phone-input placeholder is exactly '812-3456-7890' (no + prefix). Country picker bottom sheet opens with searchable country-search-input; typing 'India' filters to 1 row (country-row-IN); selecting it closes the sheet and updates the button to '🇮🇳 +91'. Register screen mirrors the login picker (register-country-picker), correctly updates dial prefix; full register flow (name 'TEST_India' + India +91 + local digits 9XXXXXXXX + register-submit-button) navigates to Verify. Verify screen: KPChat PNG logo present (3 img instances incl. AppLogo header — no shield icon), dev-code-hint displays 'Mode Demo' + 6-digit code, verify-code-input has autoComplete='sms-otp' + inputmode='numeric' + maxlength=6 + autoFocus, autofill-code button copies dev_code into the input, verify-submit-button lands on chats-screen. E2E: Register with picker->India + local -> body shows full E.164 '+91989377508' on Verify screen; TokenOut round-trip works (chats-screen renders). Splash: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx uses expo-image with require('../assets/images/kpchat-logo.png') + ActivityIndicator — logo asset exists at /app/frontend/assets/images/kpchat-logo.png (209KB). MINOR GAP: The review spec asks the underlying web <input> to have autocomplete='one-time-code'. React Native's autoComplete='sms-otp' is passed through to react-native-web as-is (DOM shows autocomplete='sms-otp'), which is the correct Android RN value but NOT the browser/iOS Safari web standard 'one-time-code'. textContentType='oneTimeCode' is set (correct for iOS native), and importantForAutofill='yes' is set (correct for Android native), so the native app is fully correct — but the web-only DOM assertion fails. Deprecated packages check: none (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Non-blocking pre-existing warnings: 'shadow* style deprecated → boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' (already flagged in iter1/2/3, unrelated to this feature).

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web console warnings ('shadow* → boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents') — unrelated to this feature, already flagged.

react_native_issues.issue: autoComplete='sms-otp' passes through to react-native-web as autocomplete='sms-otp' in the DOM. The review spec requires autocomplete='one-time-code' on web. Recommend Platform.select({ web: 'one-time-code', android: 'sms-otp', ios: 'one-time-code', default: 'sms-otp' }) so browsers (and iOS Safari) get the WHATWG-standard token while Android RN keeps its native token. textContentType='oneTimeCode' + importantForAutofill='yes' are set correctly for native. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/verify.tsx:105.

test_report_links: Prior: /app/test_reports/iteration_3.json (backend 14/14 pass — no re-run since backend unchanged this iter)
action_items: Only cosmetic gap vs. spec: change autoComplete on verify-code-input to Platform.select({ web: 'one-time-code', ios: 'one-time-code', android: 'sms-otp', default: 'sms-otp' }) so the web preview DOM asserts autocomplete='one-time-code' and iOS Safari gets the correct autofill hint. Native (iOS/Android) already works via textContentType/importantForAutofill.
(Optional pre-existing) Silence 'shadow* deprecated' RN-Web warnings by migrating to style.boxShadow.
critical_code_review_comments: CountryPicker uses @gorhom/bottom-sheet with BottomSheetFlatList + backdropComponent + snapPoints=['85%'] + enablePanDownToClose — good UX. index=-1 default (closed) with forwardRef+useImperativeHandle(open/close) is clean.
COUNTRIES list = 57 curated entries with unique keyExtractor 'code+dial' (safe since Canada +1 and US +1 share dial). DEFAULT_COUNTRY = Indonesia (+62) per spec.

fullPhone concatenation in login.tsx:26 and register.tsx:27 uses country.dial + localPhone.replace(/^0+/,'').replace(/\D/g,'') — correctly strips leading zeros AND non-digits BEFORE prefixing dial. Confirmed via body 'text +91989377508' on Verify.

AppLogo (src/components/AppLogo.tsx) is a thin wrapper around expo-image with borderRadius = size*0.22 and overflow:hidden — clean, reusable, size-prop parameterized (login=104, register=92, verify=80, splash=140).
app/index.tsx splash uses expo-image directly (not AppLogo wrapper) with a slightly larger logo and centered ActivityIndicator — acceptable inconsistency; could reuse <AppLogo size={140}/> for DRY.
verify.tsx keeps textContentType='oneTimeCode' + importantForAutofill='yes' — iOS and Android native autofill will work. Only web DOM autocomplete token differs (see action_items).

Both login and register mount <CountryPicker/> at the KeyboardAvoidingView root — during Expo Router transitions BOTH auth screens may briefly be in the DOM, resulting in 2x country-search-input elements. NOT a user-facing bug (only the active screen's picker is opened), but tests must scope to :visible.
server.py unchanged this iter (779 lines — still exceeds 700-line guideline, flagged in iter3).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on primary flows (logo, default +62, picker search, India +91 select, register->verify->chats, dev-code-hint, autofill, splash). Minor spec-vs-native mismatch on web autocomplete token flagged (does not block native release).

seed_data_creation: Created 2 fresh users via OTP flow with unique time-based phone numbers under +91 (e.g. +91989377508 named 'TEST_India'). No cleanup — each run uses a fresh phone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iter is frontend-only (backend unchanged, iter3 backend suite still valid). New testIDs added: login-country-picker, register-country-picker, country-search-input, country-row-<ISO2> (e.g. country-row-IN, country-row-US, country-row-SG), splash-screen. AppLogo component wraps assets/images/kpchat-logo.png — verify by 'img[src*=kpchat-logo]'. When testing register flow, use page.locator('[data-testid=country-search-input]:visible').first because BOTH login and register mount their own CountryPicker sibling — DOM contains 2 hidden search inputs during transitions. Autofill test: click autofill-code Pressable inside dev-code-hint; verifies dev_code copied into verify-code-input. Full E.164 assertion: after picking country X + typing local digits, the Verify screen subtitle renders params.phone which is server-normalized country.dial + local (leading zeros stripped).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only spec deviation is verify-code-input DOM autocomplete='sms-otp' vs. requested 'one-time-code' on web. Root cause: React Native autoComplete='sms-otp' is passed through to react-native-web verbatim; the WHATWG-standard token for browser OTP autofill is 'one-time-code' (Safari 12+). Mitigation: Platform.select on autoComplete in verify.tsx:105.
